notes: Adds missing robustness, fallback handling, and observability stories without duplicating prior schema/core/API/test coverage.

stories.title: Handle Unsupported or Missing State Board Coverage
stories.description: Implement fallback logic when a provider’s state is not in the supported board link registry. The system should return a null-safe disciplinary signal with a clear 'link_unavailable' indicator and avoid broken URLs.

stories.title: Normalize State Input for Board Lookup
stories.description: Add normalization logic to ensure provider state values (abbreviations, lowercase, inconsistent formats) correctly map to the board link registry, preventing lookup failures due to formatting inconsistencies.

stories.title: Add Lightweight Caching for Board Link Generation
stories.description: Introduce a simple in-memory or request-scoped cache for generated and validated board links to reduce repeated URL construction and validation overhead within the same session.

stories.title: Add Debug Logging for Disciplinary Signal Decisions
stories.description: Instrument debug_logger to capture when disciplinary signals are generated, including state mapping, link generation outcome, and fallback usage, enabling traceability during QA and SIT.
